purpose: Teach: 堅持/不均衡/商会/公訴/報い/困窮/参る/折り合い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営方針、本気で、絶対、堅持、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Hold to our management principles with absolute conviction. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority without theatrics. Weight on each clause. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone whose expectations are not negotiable but whose respect is already earned.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の、本気で、絶対、不均衡、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're closely monitoring market imbalances and their impact on our position. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Formal attentiveness. Precise pacing — no rush, no stumbling. Respectful but not deferential. The cadence of someone documenting a directive they intend to follow through on.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業以来の、本気で、絶対、商会、絶対、名、絶対、守れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Protect the reputation of this company — the one we've built since our founding. I'm trusting you with that.
lines.style: Quiet weight. Lean slightly forward on 「守れ」. Not a threat; a responsibility being placed directly in his hands. Slight pause before the closer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、公訴、絶対、対応、絶対、弁護士と、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're working with our legal counsel on the matter and coordinating our response carefully. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Clear, measured report-back. Professional without being stiff. Each sentence lands — he's showing he understands what was asked and that it's in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長年の信頼の、本気で、絶対、報い、絶対、お得意様、絶対、にお返ししろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Return the trust our long-standing clients have given us. Go to them yourself. Show them we remember what they've done for us.
lines.style: Firmer now, more personal. Less a directive, more a call to character. Open slightly on 「自ら」 — he wants to see Kenji understand *why* this matters, not just *that* it does.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、困窮、絶対、家庭、絶対、支援、絶対、当社、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're already supporting families in the community who are struggling. That commitment is ongoing.
lines.style: Steady confirmation with quiet pride underneath. He's not just checking off a box — he's showing Hiroshi that this work is already underway, already valued.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様に、本気で、絶対、自ら、絶対、参る、絶対、姿勢、絶対、忘れるな、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Never forget: when you face our clients, you go as ourselves — humble, present, accountable. Not as representatives. As ourselves.
lines.style: Direct, almost intimate despite the formality. Slow on 「自ら」. The distinction matters and he wants Kenji to feel it. Final push of emphasis without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働組合と、本気で、絶対、折り合い、絶対、つけて、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood, sir. We're in active negotiation with the union and moving forward deliberately. Thank you for your trust.
lines.style: Closing note — slightly softer than previous updates but still grounded. Shows the work continues across all fronts. Respectful sign-off.
